title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement

messages.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – part:360020, multi-year proposal
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for your offer. Our volume is 20,000 pc a year, and we would welcome a multi-year agreement.

PPI-C2815 moved from 118.8 (idx:PPI-C2815@2025-08) to 119.8 (idx:PPI-C2815@2026-08), a change of 0.84%.
LCI-C moved from 116.5 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06) to 119.6 (idx:LCI-C@2026-06), a change of 2.66%.
Our forecast fc:360020@2026-09 records a volume change of +4.2% for this bearing.

Weighted by your own cost shares, these figures support roughly 4.42 EUR against our current 4.39 EUR, not 4.96 EUR. We propose 24 months at 4.45 EUR with 60 days net, as in the attached term sheets.

Could you share a cost breakdown, or have your pricing authority review this?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – part:360020, multi-year proposal
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position.

Regarding your request for a cost breakdown, please understand that as a matter of company policy, we do not share detailed internal cost structures. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

We appreciate your interest in a multi-year agreement and can accommodate the 24-month term with 60 days net payment. Our Angebot is a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. For this 24-month package, we can offer a revised price of €4.91 per unit. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 60 days net: €4.91 per unit. As an alternative, we offer a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

Our offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
